description:
“Can we really break up properly?” Kang-san, who had lived with Hyun-min as a roommate for a year and as a lover for two years, suddenly disappears. The last message came saying he left his phone behind, and though he promised to return soon, a whole week passes without a word. In the midst of growing anxiety and loneliness, Hyun-min sees Kang-san in a half-asleep daze. But before he can feel any relief, Kang-san comes back and drops a shocking declaration.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=190199), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/until_farewell_is_over), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000056362), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/goodbyeend)
